_meta.purpose: Recall check: items on the authority's own listing page compared with what the engine ingested from that authority (any source), over the period both cover.
_meta.method: Listing items dated before our oldest entry for the authority are out of period and not counted. A listing item is matched when an ingested entry has the same canonical URL, the same normalised title, or passes the story-similarity rule of regwatch_sources/dedupe.py.
